quote.translation: Mises defines probability as follows: "The limiting value of the relative frequency with which a given mark appears (with the proviso that this limiting value must be insensitive to place selection) is called the probability of the appearance of this mark within the collective under consideration" (Richard von Mises, Wahrscheinlichkeit, Statistik und Wahrheit, 1928, S. 29).

quote.translation: Relative frequency (relative Häufigkeit) corresponds to the fraction of which Laplace speaks, but Mises, from the standpoint of empirical or statistical probability, makes the determination of the limiting value of relative frequency his main aim.

regions.text: ゼスは経験前確率すなはち就計前確率の立場から、相謝前頻数の極限値を決定すべきことを主眼としてるる。極隈値が簡所選擇に對して無感覺（segenStellenauswahlunempfindlich）であるとは、極限値が簡所選擇によつて何等の影響をも受けない意である。

quote.translation: That the limiting value is insensitive to place selection (gegen Stellenauswahl unempfindlich) means that the limiting value is in no way affected by place selection, place selection being the singling out of only a certain place, or a certain part, of a series.

regions.text: 俯所選擇をは系列中の或る儲所或る部分だけを特に選擇することである。

quote.translation: As an example of a case in which the limiting value is affected by place selection, he gives a highway on which a small milestone stands every hundred metres and a large milestone every thousand metres.

regions.text: 箇所選擇によつて極限値が影響を受ける場合の例として、衝道に百メートル毎に小さい標石が立ちチメートル毎に大きい標石が立つてゐる場合が船げてある。その街道を長距離に左つて歩いて行けは、標石の系列中で大きい標石にぶつかる相對的頻数の極限催が1一10であることがわかる。

quote.translation: If we walk along this highway for a long distance, we find that the limiting value of the relative frequency with which we come upon a large milestone in the series of milestones is 1/10.

regions.text: 然るに若し、標石の系列に選擇を行つて、例へば小さい標石を一つ置きにだけ注意することとしたならば大きい標石の相動約頻數は最早や1Qではなくして1一5に選じてしまふのである。

quote.translation: If, however, we make a selection within the series of milestones and decide, for example, to attend only to every other small milestone, the relative frequency of the large milestones is no longer 1/10 but changes to 1/5.

regions.text: すなはち、この場合には、自由選擇によつて要素の一部を特に全體から取り出してそれだけを注意すると、相對的

quote.translation: In this case, that is, when by free selection a part of the elements is singled out from the whole and attention is paid to that part alone, the limiting value of the relative frequency is affected.
